notes: Ids come from tokenizers reading the checkpoint's tokenizer.json: empty normalizer, three Split stages, Digits(individual_digits), ByteLevel(add_prefix_space=false), then BPE with 130716 merges and 113 added tokens.
Rendered bytes come from Transformers' _compile_jinja_template (trim_blocks, lstrip_blocks, loopcontrols, Python tojson, namespace, raise_exception), the engine apply_chat_template drives.
The artifact's trunk GGUF carries this template verbatim under tokenizer.chat_template; crates/ds4-core/src/spark2_5.rs verifies that copy against template_sha256 at load.
generation_config.json eos_token_id is 1 (<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>); <｜end▁of▁text｜> (7) is a different token and is not a stop.
make_eval_cases.py takes an optional fuzz-case count for a wider differential run; the committed corpus uses the default 120.
